data: Is the Sentence Encoder located to the right of the last phase?

The caption states that during target training and evaluation phases, copies are made of the sentence encoder model. This implies that the sentence encoder is not located in the last phase but rather in the preparation phase. The figure shows the sentence encoder being loaded before the intermediate training phase, which is the first phase after the preparation phase. Therefore, the sentence encoder is not located to the right of the last phase.
